references.use: Image sequences import as frames in one video layer with a chosen frame rate; this changed the implementation plan before code was written.
Retain Render Video/image-sequence export, numbering and frame-range requirements for the next stage.

public_references.provenance: Public Adobe behavior descriptions, original Swift implementation and owned deterministic raster inputs. No Adobe implementation code or user artwork. No live comparison is claimed.
public_references.adobe_v2: Pinned public schema has no dedicated video/image-sequence endpoint. Generic animation execute-actions descriptors remain required and unimplemented.

api.adobe: No dedicated video endpoint in the pinned public contract; generic execute-actions animation descriptors remain unimplemented.

independent_output: Three original PNG frames, numeric order, 4x3 positions and partial alpha. All144 output RGBA samples match independent Pillow expectations; no Photoshop-equivalence claim.
ui: Native video Timeline controls and import picker; offscreen layout test passes. No live UI or Photoshop comparison accepted.
limits: In-memory PNG image sequences only; AVFoundation movie import, audio, keyframes/transitions and complete Render Video remain required.
PNG sequence export, file/ZIP API transfer, additional source formats and full metadata remain required.
Whole-frame geometry/profile/mode conversion and additional rich-layer contexts are not implemented across video frames; unsupported operations reject atomically.
Editable PSD video interchange, semantic Actions, generic Adobe video descriptors, factory preference/default/shortcut fidelity and full video-layer menus remain open.
Desktop1–512 PNG frames with1GiB decoded budget; API1–7 explicitly shared still documents with128MiB frame budget plus ordinary4MP/64-layer sharing limits.
Universal package and macOS14/Intel/macOS26 runtime qualification, live acceptance and Photoshop byte-identical results remain unverified.
